notes: Verified entry list, grid and final classification. Location-based 3D is only enabled when an actual recorded positional snapshot is bundled.
Calendar race time is scheduled UTC; a replay origin is only established when a recorded session-start record is available. Final classification is distinct from live position updates.
Lap times, compounds, intervals and positional telemetry are shown only when separately available. Results are never converted into invented car trajectories.

Jolpica pit-stop lap and reported duration are available. The displayed pit clock uses its reported UTC message against the scheduled start, so delayed/restarted races do not have an exact replay clock. No lap trajectories, tyre compounds or stationary stop times are invented.

All available driver lap durations use the public Jolpica CSV export. Elapsed start/end clocks are derived cumulative durations, not original timestamped telemetry. Missing lap records leave subsequent elapsed clocks unavailable. Sectors, tyre compounds and coordinates remain unavailable. Red-flag suspensions can prevent cumulative lap clocks from matching official elapsed classification time.
